lessons_used: 'adoption, redesign' changes have shown helpful, positive results after noise correction across 2 tests, backed by a winning test.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, and 13 were underestimated.

candidates.title: pick_friend_two_column_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into a two-column layout featuring an expanded live preview on the left and pet choice cards on the right.
candidates.why: Lessons show that adoption redesigns consistently yield positive conversion gains, and adoption is currently a major funnel drop-off at 68.4%.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: home_intro_spotlight_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the finish onboarding screen into a spotlight layout that highlights essential controls and desktop pet interaction steps.
candidates.why: Finish screen drop-off is high (64.8% conversion) with a mean time of 5815s, and support logs show confusion on controlling or finding the pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is active on your screen. Click and drag your pet or check the system tray to manage pet settings.

home_welcome.text: Click your pet directly on the desktop to interact or hide it anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro spotlight screen within onboarding while preserving its core function.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop-off (35.2%) and strong support evidence, but screen redesigns here previously measured -2.1%.

candidates.title: new_waiting_progress_companion_screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated waiting companion screen that displays an animated preparation process while the desktop pet is generated.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs while assets load.

new_waiting_companion.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space
new_waiting_companion.body: We are getting your companion ready to jump onto your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a new waiting companion screen inside onboarding without removing any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time on home step, but adding new screens/flows has consistently shown weak or neutral results.

candidates.title: sign_in_reorder_after_adoption
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding flow so that sign-in happens after pet adoption selection instead of before.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users before they get to choose a pet, creating unnecessary early friction.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after adoption selection is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in has 27.1% drop-off, but reordering sign-in previously resulted in a significant -6.9% drop.

candidates.title: upload_photos_file_format_hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit photo formatting hint to the photo upload screen explaining lighting and background requirements.
candidates.why: Support logs show 3 user reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during photo upload.

upload_photos.hint: Use a clear, well-lit image (JPG or PNG) with good contrast for best custom pet results.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful file formatting hint to the upload photos step.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops 31.6%; simple copy/hint additions on adoption steps carry low risk and high confidence.

candidates.title: waiting_time_estimate_display
candidates.change: Display a visible step counter and estimated time remaining during the pet creation waiting phase.
candidates.why: Users spend up to 2336s on average on the waiting step without feedback on how long rendering will take.

waiting.headline: Building Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Rendering custom pet animations. This usually takes about 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Displays step counter and time estimate during a real wait screen as permitted by rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Home step has lower drop-off (18.7%), but adding time estimates addresses extreme wait times at config-only cost.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_visibility_copy
candidates.change: Update final screen headlines and text to explicitly explain where the pet appears on the desktop and taskbar.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or users being unable to open the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!
home_intro.body: Look at your desktop or system tray icon. Click on your pet at any time to interact or open pet settings.

guard.reason: Updates onboarding copy on the home intro screen to clarify pet desktop visibility.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop-off and strong support complaint volume; copy clarification is low cost and high leverage.

candidates.title: waiting_ready_desktop_notification
candidates.change: Enable optional system notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet setup completes.
candidates.why: High average waiting times cause users to switch away to other apps and drop off before finishing.

waiting.hint: We will send a system notification as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a system notification prompt to the waiting screen, allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Helps re-engage users during long 2336s wait times, though target step drop-off is relatively low.

candidates.title: choose_path_starter_bonus_badge
candidates.change: Add a prominent starter bonus badge on the path selection screen highlighting instant companion perk unlocks.
candidates.why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users immediately on launch with a long mean duration of 514s.

guard.reason: Promoting a starter perk unlock in onboarding copy violates Rule 3 prohibiting mentions of gifts, discounts, or free extras.

candidates.title: sign_in_compact_layout_view
candidates.change: Switch sign-in screen to a compact layout emphasizing account continuity and existing user account syncing.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different or duplicate account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync Your Pets
sign_in.body: Please use your primary login to ensure all your pets and unlocked accessories stay connected.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in layout to a compact view without altering required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 emails), but past sign_in redesigns consistently showed negative lift (-3.8%).
